meta.title: MWORKS AI
meta.description: Brings MWORKS into DeepSeek Harness the way the official Syslab AI and Sysplorer AI assistants do: it bridges the two official MCP servers over stdio (mcp__mworks_syslab__* for Julia execution, environment detection, help search and MATLAB-to-Julia mapping; mcp__mworks_sysplorer__* for Modelica modeling, checking, translation, simulation, results and library documentation), and adds the official MWORKS working rules to the agent instructions. This bundle page then carries a Runtime environment section reporting the detected Syslab and Sysplorer installations and versions, the Julia runtime, whether each MCP server has the paths it needs, and which MWORKS skills this session can call, with a Re-detect button. Nothing is added to the conversation: no composer control and no chat row. Tool availability comes from the installed products, so Syslab must be present for the Julia tools and Sysplorer for the Modelica tools. The section reports installation state, not connection health: the tool counts are what the official servers declare, and a tool call is the only proof that one answered. Tool calls can run for minutes, so they use a five-minute timeout. The plugin only reads installation paths and version files and writes nothing into the MWORKS directories. Turning it off removes both MCP connections, the tool, the instructions and the section.
